app.name: Roshan Rozgar
app.tagline: Skilled workers near you, when you need them

landing.title: Find a trusted worker nearby
landing.subtitle: Electricians, plumbers, AC technicians, carpenters and mechanics in Islamabad and Rawalpindi.
landing.customerHint: Describe the problem by voice, text or a photo
landing.workerHint: Make your profile by speaking — no forms

landing.pickRoleOnce: Choose once. You can't change this later.

home.heroSub: Connect with trusted electricians, plumbers, and mechanics in your neighborhood.
home.heroImageAlt: A smiling electrician in a navy uniform with a tool belt, standing in front of a house with his van
home.step1Body: Explain your problem in your own voice, no typing needed.
home.step2Body: See who is close to you and ready for work right now.
home.step3Body: Agree on a fair price and book based on your convenience.
home.w1Title: Speak in Urdu or Roman Urdu
home.w1Body: Don't worry about filling forms, just tell us in your own tongue.
home.w2Body: The app will read out every question to you.
home.w3Body: Just tap one button to show your availability to nearby customers.
home.h1Body: Instead of waiting for hours, find someone who is close and ready.
home.h2Body: Speak directly to the worker to explain your problem.
home.h3Body: Talk first to avoid any unexpected costs later.
home.sampleQuote: “I'll be free at 3:00 PM and I'm working nearby.”
home.trustTitle: How trust works on our platform?
home.trust1Body: After every job, customers rate the worker. We don't allow fake reviews.
home.trust2Body: For workers with no reviews yet, we show it clearly so they can start their first job honestly.
home.installBody: Add it to your home screen. Works even on weak internet connections.
home.footerAbout: A simple platform connecting Pakistan's skilled tradespeople with households.
home.footerDemoBody: Sample data and test login, no SMS or payments.

consent.title: Before you use the microphone
consent.body: If you speak, your voice is recorded for a few seconds and sent to Groq (speech to text) and Google Gemini (understanding). Your name, phone and address are never sent. We do not keep the recording after it is understood. Everything you say is shown to you first, and you always confirm it.

guide.title: Hear instructions
guide.login: Choose how to sign in. Press the Google button, or use your phone number and the big number keys. This is a demo login, so no message is sent.
guide.roleChooser: Press the picture that describes you. Press Worker if you do the work. Press Customer if you need work done. You can choose only once.

onboarding.trade: Press the picture of the work you do. You can also press the microphone and say it, for example: I am an electrician.
onboarding.years: Press the plus button for each year you have worked. Press minus to go down. You can also say it, for example: eight years.
onboarding.areas: Press every area where you are happy to work. You can also say the names, for example: F-7 and G-9.
onboarding.rate: Press the price you usually charge, then press how you charge: per visit, per hour or per job. You can also say it, for example: fifteen hundred per visit.
onboarding.schedule: Press the days you are free, then press the times of day. You can also say it, for example: Monday to Friday, morning and afternoon.
onboarding.photo: You can add your photo so customers know who is coming. This is optional. Press Skip if you do not want to.
onboarding.readback: Please check your profile. If a line is wrong, press it to change it. If everything is right, press the green save button.

guide.customerOnboarding: Type your name, then press your area. You can press Use my location to find it. Then choose your language.
guide.requestNew: Tell us what you need. Press the picture of the work, or press the microphone and describe the problem. Then choose when you need the worker.
guide.results: These are workers near you who are free at your time. Each card says why it is shown. Press a worker to see more.
guide.workerProfile: This is the worker's profile. It shows their work, their price and what other customers said.
